title: Lattice chemistry damping stabilization enables voltage stability and oxygen redox reversibility in Li-rich layered oxides
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1642-1657
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06116D, Paper
Lingcai Zeng, Yaqian Wang, Tong Li, Bao Qiu, Jiajie Pan, Haoyan Liang, Junhao Li, Xiaolei Sun, Jianrong Zeng, Kaixiang Shi, Zhaoping Liu, Quanbing Liu
Lattice chemistry damping via radial disorder gradients regulates oxygen activity and strain in Li-rich. The cooperative surface-bulk damping stabilizes redox and mitigates voltage decay, enabling 81.3% retention after 800th with 0.64 mV/cycle decay.
